test_title: PYST 27: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following brings winter rainfall to northern plains of India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Western disturbances**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Western disturbances** are extratropical storms originating in the **Mediterranean region**.
 
• They travel eastward and bring **winter rainfall** to the **northern plains of India**, particularly in **Punjab, Haryana, and western Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• These disturbances are caused due to the westerly winds in the upper atmosphere, which carry moisture from the **Mediterranean Sea**, the **Atlantic Ocean**, and sometimes even from the **Caspian Sea**.
 
• The rainfall brought by these disturbances is crucial for the **rabi crops**, especially **wheat**, in northern India.
 
• They usually occur during the **winter months**, from December to February, though they can sometimes extend into early March.
 
• The interaction of Western disturbances with the Himalayas often leads to snowfall in the **higher altitudes** and rainfall in the plains.
 
• This phenomenon plays a significant role in maintaining the **climate balance** in the region by lowering temperatures and providing moisture.
 
• Western disturbances are also responsible for causing **cold waves** in northern India during winters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Norwesters**__

 __
 
• **Norwesters**, also called **Kalbaisakhi** in India, are thunderstorms that occur during the **pre-monsoon season**, mainly in **eastern India**, such as West Bengal, Assam, and Odisha.
 
• These storms are characterized by strong winds, heavy rainfall, and sometimes hailstorms, but they are not responsible for winter rainfall.
 
 
 
• **Bay of Bengal cyclones**__
 __
 
• **Bay of Bengal cyclones** are tropical cyclones that form over the **Bay of Bengal**, typically during the **pre-monsoon (April-May)** and **post-monsoon (October-November)** seasons.
 
• These cyclones are responsible for heavy rainfall in the eastern coastal states of India but do not impact the winter rainfall in northern plains.
 
 
 
• **Easterlies**__
 
 
• **Easterlies** are trade winds that blow from the east to the west in the **tropical regions**.
 
• They are associated with the monsoon season in India and do not contribute to winter rainfall in the northern plains.
